title: Fire Tracker normalized telemetry envelope
description: Canonical output from the bridge/SDK. HTTP input may omit optional measurements; normalization fills them with null. t is the GPS observation time, not a heartbeat time.

alt.description: Metres above home/takeoff reference; not terrain AGL

alt_msl.description: Metres above mean sea level, only when known

hdg.description: Heading in degrees clockwise from north

spd.description: Horizontal ground speed, metres per second

link.description: e.g. mavlink, dji, http, ws, sim

t.description: UTC GPS observation/reception time, normalized to milliseconds

simulated.description: True for training data; link=sim forces true
